title: Blackstone Expands Into Essential Home Services With Champions Group Deal
title_zh: Blackstone 通过 Champions Group 交易扩展到基本家庭服务
summary: Blackstone (NYSE:BX) has signed a definitive deal to acquire Champions Group, a major home services provider. The transaction will see Odyssey Investment Partners retain a significant minority stake in Champions Group.
summary_zh: Blackstone（纽约证券交易所股票代码：BX）已签署收购主要家庭服务提供商 Champions Group 的最终协议。此次交易将使 Odyssey Investment Partners 保留 Champions Group 的大量少数股权。

title: Citizens Financial Strengthens Advisory Platform With Matrix Deal
title_zh: Citizens Financial 通过 Matrix Deal 加强咨询平台
summary: CFG is set to expand its advisory platform through the planned acquisition of Matrix, expanding expertise in Downstream Energy & Convenience Retail.
summary_zh: CFG 将通过计划收购 Matrix 来扩大其咨询平台，扩大下游能源和便利零售领域的专业知识。

title: Blackstone Nears $2.5 Billion Deal for Champions Group
title_zh: Blackstone 接近以 25 亿美元收购 Champions Group
summary: Private equity firm said to be close to acquiring landscaping services provider.
summary_zh: 据称私募股权公司即将收购园林绿化服务提供商。

title: Blackstone Inc (BX) Strikes Big Deal in Women’s Healthcare Space
title_zh: Blackstone Inc (BX) 在女性医疗保健领域达成重大交易
summary: Blackstone Inc (NYSE:BX) is one of the best NYSE stocks to buy for the long term. Blackstone Inc (NYSE:BX) led a $10 billion debt investment in the Australian AI infrastructure company Firmus, Reuters reported on February 9.
summary_zh: 黑石公司（纽约证券交易所代码：BX）是最适合长期购买​​的纽约证券交易所股票之一。据路透社 2 月 9 日报道，黑石公司（纽约证券交易所股票代码：BX）牵头对澳大利亚人工智能基础设施公司 Firmus 进行了 100 亿美元的债务投资。

title: ARES Signals Strong 2026 Deal Momentum, Reaffirms Growth Targets
title_zh: ARES 预示 2026 年交易势头强劲，重申增长目标
summary: Ares Management signals accelerating 2026 deal momentum with record pipeline and reaffirms double-digit growth targets.
summary_zh: Ares Management 表示将通过创纪录的管道加速 2026 年的交易势头，并重申两位数的增长目标。
